_comment: Merge into a composed checkout's .claude/settings.json (folio-assistant, or any index that mounts cat-harness-tools at cat-harness-tools/). It runs the fast gates before an agent's `git push` and blocks the push only on a new failure; see scripts/pre-push-gates.ts and bean cat-tools-pp9g. The `[ ! -f ]` guard keeps it a no-op in a checkout whose cat-harness-tools pin predates the hook. For cat-harness-tools checked out on its own, the path is scripts/git-hooks/claude-pre-push.sh.
